reason: eBay publishes its own MCP server, github.com/eBay/npm-public-api-mcp ('eBay API MCP Server': discovers eBay REST OpenAPI specs and calls them with application or user OAuth tokens minted from a Client ID/Secret; production is GET-only, i.e. Browse item search/get for buying-side reads). The Buy API reference itself (https://developer.ebay.com/api-docs/buy/browse/resources/item_summary/methods/search) still answers 403 'Something went wrong on our end' to plain HTTP and to headless Chromium on 2026-09-25, and the server's spec search (https://api.ebay.com/developer/mcp/v1/search) needs an eBay token, so no endpoint is wrapped here; the Buy Order API stays limited to approved eBay Partner Network partners and the seller side is ecommerce_channels/ebay.
